business_summary: Shandong Boyuan Pharmaceutical & Chemical Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of fine chemicals in China. It operates in four segments: Iodine Derivatives, Industrial Catalysts (precious metals), Organosilicon Series, and Chemiluminescent Materials. The company offers iodine derivatives, such as potassium iodide, sodium iodide, cesium iodide, potassium iodate, methyl iodide, diiodomethane, hydriodic acid, copper iodide, and iodotrimethylsilane; and fine chemicals, including hexamethyldisilazane, hexamethyldisilane, hexamethyldisiloxane, tris(dioxa-3,6-heptyl)amine, tris(2-(2-methoxyethoxy)ethyl)amine, and tris(3,6-dioxaheptyl)amine. It also provides chemiluminescent products comprising 3,5-dichlorosalicylic acid; 3,5,6-trichlorosalicylic acid; bis(2,4,5-trichloro-6-carbopentoxyphenyl) oxalate; and bis(2,4,5-trichloro-6-i-pentoxycarbonylphenyl) oxalate. In addition, the company offers precious metal catalysts, such as rhodium(ii) octanoate dimer, rhodium(iii) iodide, wilkinson's catalyst, palladium acetate, rhodium(iii) chloride hydrate, palladium chloride, chloroplatinic acid hexahydrate, potassium platinochloride, potassium hexachloroplatinate, ruthenium(iii) chloride hydrate, rhodium (triphenylphosphine)carbonylacetylacetonate, tetrakis(triphenylphosphine)palladium, palladium on carbon, and ruthenium on carbon. Further, its products are used in the field of pharmaceuticals, food, feed, chemical industry, new materials, optoelectronic materials, etc. Additionally, the company exports its products. Shandong Boyuan Pharmaceutical & Chemical Co., Ltd. was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Shouguang, China.
business_summary_ko: Shandong Boyuan Pharmaceutical & Chemical Co., Ltd.는 중국에서 정밀 화학제품의 연구 개발, 생산 및 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. 요오드 유도체, 산업용 촉매(귀금속), 유기실리콘 시리즈, 화학발광 재료 등 4개 부문으로 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 요오드화칼륨, 요오드화나트륨, 요오드화세슘, 요오드화칼륨, 요오드화메틸, 디요오드메탄, 요오드화수소산, 요오드화구리 및 요오도트리메틸실란과 같은 요오드 유도체를 제공합니다. 헥사메틸디실라잔, 헥사메틸디실란, 헥사메틸디실록산, 트리스(디옥사-3,6-헵틸)아민, 트리스(2-(2-메톡시에톡시)에틸)아민, 트리스(3,6-디옥사헵틸)아민 등의 정밀화학제품 등이 있습니다. 또한 3,5-디클로로살리실산; 3,5,6-트리클로로살리실산; 비스(2,4,5-트리클로로-6-카르보펜톡시페닐) 옥살레이트; 및 비스(2,4,5-트리클로로-6-1-펜톡시카르보닐페닐) 옥살레이트. 또한, 회사는 로듐(ii) 옥타노에이트 이량체, 로듐(iii) 요오드화물, 윌킨슨 촉매, 팔라듐 아세테이트, 로듐(iii) 염화수화물, 팔라듐 염화물, 염화백금산 6수화물, 백금백금산칼륨, 육염화백금산칼륨과 같은 귀금속 촉매를 제공합니다.
